name: Quito Motorcycle Rental / Fleet Staging
summary: Planning pin for contracting a legal rental fleet, mechanic, sweep and recovery support.
safetyNotes: Inspect insurance, licensing, deposits, roadside coverage and off-road restrictions.
filmingNotes: Record serial numbers and condition photos with operator consent.
verificationNote: The app intentionally stores no unverified current vendor price or address.

sections.title: Fleet contract
sections.body: Capture bike model, VIN, maintenance history, tire/mousse setup, tool allocation, insurance exclusions and emergency replacement terms.

name: Spatial Camera Production Staging
summary: Planning environment for iPhone spatial video and a professionally operated immersive-camera package.
safetyNotes: Never mount cinema-scale immersive hardware on a rider.
Use protected stationary positions and a dedicated camera team.
filmingNotes: Log generated versus documentary footage and preserve media provenance.
verificationNote: No local URSA Cine Immersive rental is claimed; obtain a current production-house quote.

seasonalWeather.september: Protect from dust and high UV.
seasonalWeather.october: Weatherproof cases and condensation control are essential.

sections.title: Capture split
sections.body: Use iPhone for lightweight spatial moments, action cameras for rider POV and the immersive cinema system only for controlled hero placements.

name: Manta / Pacific Logistics Hub
summary: Airport, port, lodging and production-support anchor for the optional Pacific extension.
safetyNotes: Build a separate coast security, road and heat plan.
filmingNotes: Coordinate drone and commercial filming permissions separately.
verificationNote: Confirm current providers, route conditions and operating permissions.

seasonalWeather.september: Cooler coastal season with overcast periods and warm water activity.
seasonalWeather.october: Warming transition with variable cloud and showers.

sections.title: Coast reset
sections.body: Change tire/gear strategy, hydrate for heat and recheck surf, tides and coastal-road conditions.

name: Rotary Coordination — Manta
summary: Potential District 4400 coordination point on the Manabí coast.
safetyNotes: Confirm the specific club, project, host and location.
filmingNotes: Keep project claims source-linked and consent-forward.
verificationNote: District 4400 confirms Rotary presence in Manta; this pin is not a confirmed appointment.

sections.title: Project verification
sections.body: Do not enable a donation-delivery workflow until recipient needs, ownership, support and data-security responsibilities are documented.

name: Canoa Surf Stop
summary: Optional northern Manabí surf and beach-production stop.
safetyNotes: Check surf, rip currents, tides, security and local guidance before entering water.
filmingNotes: Keep motorcycles off sensitive beach areas and secure all equipment.
verificationNote: Surf and access conditions are live and require local confirmation.

sections.title: Surf protocol
sections.body: Use a qualified local surf guide, buddy system and a separate water-safety plan.

name: Bahía de Caráquez
summary: Coastal connector, lodging and estuary-area context for the E15 extension.
safetyNotes: Confirm bridge, road and local security conditions.
filmingNotes: Avoid disturbing mangrove or wildlife areas.
verificationNote: Current route and lodging status must be checked.

sections.title: Ecology
sections.body: Use local environmental guidance before mapping or publishing sensitive habitat locations.

name: Ayampe Surf Finish
summary: Lower-key Pacific finale with beach, forest and a controlled sunset film sequence.
safetyNotes: Check surf hazards, tides, access, security and community expectations.
filmingNotes: Use a stationary beach-edge immersive setup outside the impact zone.
verificationNote: Confirm surf guide, lodging, beach access and commercial filming rules.

seasonalWeather.september: Cooler coastal light, clouds and wind possible.
seasonalWeather.october: Warmer transition with variable shower risk.

sections.title: Finale
sections.body: Boards travel in the support vehicle; no dangerous board mounting on enduro motorcycles.

name: Montañita Surf / Social Stop
summary: High-energy optional surf and nightlife stop on the Spondylus corridor.
safetyNotes: Use a transport plan that separates riding from alcohol or fatigue.
Secure equipment and verify local conditions.
filmingNotes: Obtain releases in crowded public-facing commercial scenes.
verificationNote: Live surf, event, lodging and security conditions require confirmation.

seasonalWeather.september: Cooler coastal pattern and possible marine cloud.

sections.title: Transport boundary
sections.body: Motorcycles are parked before any nightlife activity; designated support transport returns the team.
